name: Bonneville County, ID
findings: Bonneville County has 284 nonprofit organizations. 140 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 100 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bonneville County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 14 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.text: 2 union organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 6 would.
